name: Trussi AI
description:
Trussi AI connects your Trussi roofing CRM to Claude so your team can run the business in plain language.

Ask about your work:
- Find and open projects and customers, with full job detail (status, quotes, files, measurements)
- Check your sales pipeline, dashboard, and leaderboard
- Pull month-by-month revenue, AR/collections, and marketing-channel performance
- See calendar, labor, and delivery schedules for any day or date range
- Review profit analysis, worksheets (signed value / collected / balance due), and insurance supplements
- Read project and per-user activity timelines, and run your saved reports

Take action (with your permissions):
- Add comments, create calendar events and quotes, and move projects through the pipeline

Built for security:
- OAuth 2.0 sign-in with PKCE - Claude only sees data your account already allows
- Every request is account-scoped and capability-checked, exactly like the Trussi app
- Read and write are separate scopes you approve when connecting

Scoped automatically by role and branch, so reps, production, and owners each see the right data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trussi AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trussi AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.trussi.ai/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trussi AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trussi AI lists 32 MCP tools, including trussi_create_calendar_event, trussi_create_comment, trussi_create_quote, trussi_get_activity, trussi_get_collections, trussi_get_dashboard, trussi_get_leaderboard, trussi_get_marketing_channels, trussi_get_pipeline, trussi_get_profit_analysis, trussi_get_project, and trussi_get_project_worksheets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trussi AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trussi AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Trussi AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trussi AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trussi AI is developed by Trussi AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
